method: Joint low/high Attack fit at LPF bypass, matching the owner-confirmed real TR-909 direct-out reference. Body, pitch, Tune, envelope/DC, noise and desk held fixed. Weighted edge-aligned time residual, 8 kHz high-pass residual (x5), and 0.3-weighted log-band-energy residual against full-onset reference windows. Design-model onset has zero pre-roll; actual carried-state full-image energy is measured independently in neighbors.json. Existing pulse/filter structure and coefficient-only implementation.

parameters._note: Joint minimum/maximum Attack fit to the owner-confirmed TR-909 direct-out recording at LPF bypass. Complete body/Tune model held fixed. Full-onset spectral energy includes pre-roll; edge-aligned time residual is a fit metric, not measured trigger alignment. Existing long/fast discharge and filter structure retained. Input/filter gain scale 16 preserves fixed-point headroom. Jitter strength range is 0.92..1.0; it is an approximation, not a measured circuit mechanism.

implementedPulse._note: Joint minimum/maximum Attack fit to the owner-confirmed TR-909 direct-out recording at LPF bypass. Complete body/Tune model held fixed. Full-onset spectral energy includes pre-roll; edge-aligned time residual is a fit metric, not measured trigger alignment. Existing long/fast discharge and filter structure retained. Input/filter gain scale 16 preserves fixed-point headroom. Jitter strength range is 0.92..1.0; it is an approximation, not a measured circuit mechanism.

limits: Only endpoint windows are fit; exact intermediate physical knob positions are unknown.
Full-onset energy does not use a reference abruptly cut at its steepest negative slope.
The peak-strength distribution is only an approximation: the final 2–4 reference hits may have held the endpoint, and possible knob motion remains a confounder.
Body parameters except pulse-baseline k0 and all Tune parameters are byte-for-byte numerically unchanged from AB014REF04.
